text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't worry about it, Tsuru-chan! I 
just meant "What's up?" is all!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Teio. Looks like it's high time you 
got a little discipline, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, don't say scary things like that~! 
Today's such a nice day, too~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually, I heard that today was the 
day. So, umm—

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi & Teio
text_block_list.text: Happy birthday!! Happy birthday to you~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Sirius-san takes such good care 
of Teio-chan, after all. So we just had to 
celebrate together, the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hah. Did you come all the way here just 
to wag your tail at me?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? My tail!? T-Teio-chan, was my tail 
wagging that much...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that just now was—... Seriously! 
Don't worry about it at all! ...Looks like 
it really tickled your funny bone, though.
